name: KOI vs KARMINE CORP
description:
KOI is a Spanish esports club led by streamer Ibai, competing with another French esports club called KARMINE CORP, also known as KCORP (KC), led by streamer Kameto.

A long-running battle between the two streamers erupted, followed by a Spanish-American alliance following a French attack on a frog drawn by streamer Mizkif.
